annotations.title: Validate the JSON-LD on a page

description: Use this when someone wants their schema markup or JSON-LD checked on a specific page. Reports which schema types the page declares, which blocks fail to parse, and whether the fields that help an engine attribute a claim (sameAs, Organization identity, FAQ answers) are filled in. One fetch, no AI.

url.description: The site or page URL to check. A bare domain like example.com is fine.

name: validate_structured_data
title: Validate the JSON-LD on a page
